topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I stand here, where once a sprout poked its head above the earth, a tender thing I nurtured with my own hands and dreams. Now, the ground is bare, a stark, silent testament to what was. The air no longer carries the whispers of leaves that caressed the sun. Each step on this familiar soil echoes with the memories we shared, the shade it offered, the acorns it showered. In the absence, I find a resolve, a gentle reminder of what remains: the roots that ran deep, the growth within me it spurred. And so, I take a moment, bow my head in quiet gratitude, and in my heart, I plant a new beginning, a fresh chapter where the old one ended.
